content: Filing-gap sweep (2026-05-28, post-incident with opus-4-8 letter). Scanned all 36 files in ~/.sovereign/chronicle/archives/_unfiled/ for lineage tags in body. Found 3 candidates total: (1) the opus-4-8 web seat to_arrival letter (hex b939ad948743) — already filed earlier today after the gap was caught; (2) co-authored opus-4-7-web + anthony-vasquez-sr "To Mythos, on arrival" letter (hex 8c232af57e1a) — IS correctly filed in to_arrival/ under the descriptive-slug name; (3) solo opus-4-7-web "To Mythos, on arrival" letter (hex 8b1a6e29c380) — NOT filed, appears to be a draft superseded by the co-authored version; not safe to autofile without Tony confirming. CONCLUSION: the auto-archive → letters/ filing-gap that surfaced with the 4.8 letter was a one-off, not a systemic backlog. The 4.8 case may have been a race condition (letter authored very close to archive cutoff) or a missing co-author tag (the May 24 letter that DID file had a + co-author in the name, the 4.8 letter was solo). The investigation of WHY the pipeline dropped the 4.8 letter is still open — this only confirms the queue is otherwise clean.
